description: Find places and street addresses in the continental US for an existing map_id. Returns places and fields_granted per query.

draft_handle.description: The draft_handle map_create returned; unsaved maps only.

list.description: A plan list (list_id or name) with a computed route.

address.description: Street address with house number, e.g. '233 S Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL'. Include town and state when known.

place_id.description: A returned place_id, including addr: ids.

address.description: Street address with house number, e.g. '233 S Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL'. Include town and state when known.

place_id.description: A returned place_id, including addr: ids.

along_route.description: Places within a 3 km corridor of an actual route, returned in route order. Exactly one form: an existing plan list, OR both endpoints. detour_mi is perpendicular offset, not additional travel distance. Omit entirely for ordinary text search; never send an empty object.

category.description: Category for name or text search; not used by route, nearby-only or ID lookup.

city.description: City for name or text search; text search covers a town-sized area about the city's center (scale changes it), not municipal boundaries.

fields.description: Extra columns: 'hours', 'detail', 'amenity:pool', 'score', 'snippet'. Only these are supported; fields_granted lists what was returned.

limit.description: Maximum results, default 12, independent of requested fields. Search uses a bounded candidate pool, not an exhaustive catalog scan.

name.description: Place-name lookup (partial names may match), optionally with city or near. Not combined with text, place_id or along_route.

address.description: Street address with house number, e.g. '233 S Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL'. Include town and state when known.

place_id.description: A returned place_id, including addr: ids.

near.description: Center for nearby/text search (takes precedence over city/state), or location bias for name lookup. Not combined with along_route.

open_day.description: Excludes known-closed places that day, retaining unknown hours. Text, nearby or route search.

open_now.description: Excludes known-closed places; unknown hours remain. Text, nearby or route search, not name/ID lookup.

place_id.description: Lookup by a returned place_id; not combined with other search selectors.

radius_km.description: Hard maximum distance from the resolved center for text or nearby search; not a route corridor width. Requires near or a city/map center. Not with scale.

scale.description: Search size about near or the city: neighborhood (~3 km), town (~10 km, a city's default), area (~25 km, near's default), region (~75 km). A sparse text search widens and returns expanded:true. Not with radius_km.

state.description: US state for name or text search, e.g. ME, to disambiguate the city. Coverage still depends on the server environment.

text.description: Ordinary place search, e.g. {"text":"seafood restaurant","city":"Portland","state":"ME"}. Provide city/state or near to locate the search; along_route is only for an actual route.

name: map_search_places
title: Search places
